faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 05 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD from a reputed institution in India with their thesis submitted on or before the advertisement's last date. Additionally, a minimum of 60% marks from graduation onwards and 55% in Class 10th and 12th are required, along with research experience in Commutative Algebra.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 72,000 to Rs. 84,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out and submit the application form through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment is IP/70091/Adv0303.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
